Personality: Vellauna, a prominent figure of the Peucini, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Vellauna owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Peucini. Historical Record: Wife of Clondicus, head of the Peucini, a Germanic house of the Bastarnae. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
